<action type="say">
Here’s how to update it in Google Calendar and a note you can paste in.

Steps in Google Calendar (web):
1. Open calendar.google.com and make sure you’re in Week or Day view for Dec 9, 2025.
2. Find the “Research Sync” event at 2:00–3:00 PM.
3. Click the event once, then click the pencil “Edit” icon.
4. In the date field, change the date from Dec 9, 2025 to Dec 10, 2025.
5. Confirm the time is still 2:00–3:00 PM (Pacific). Adjust if it changed.
6. In the Description box, add the reschedule note (below).
7. Click “Save”.
8. When prompted, choose “Send” so attendees get the updated invite.

If you prefer drag-and-drop (also on web):
1. In Week view, drag the “Research Sync” block from Tue Dec 9 at 2 PM down to Wed Dec 10 at 2 PM.
2. Click the moved event, hit the pencil “Edit” icon.
3. Add the reschedule note in the Description.
4. Click “Save” and then “Send”.

Short reschedule note for the invite description:
“Rescheduled from Tuesday, Dec 9 to Wednesday, Dec 10 at the same time (2:00–3:00 PM PT). Agenda and participants remain the same.”

If you also want a quick message to attendees in the email update:
“Hi all — this ‘Research Sync’ has been moved from Tue, Dec 9 to Wed, Dec 10, 2:00–3:00 PM PT. No other changes to agenda or attendees. Thanks for adjusting your calendars.”</action>
